# postward-creative-mcp

> Local-first MCP server (stdio) for video and image editing with ffmpeg
> and ImageMagick, driven by natural language. 100% offline: no API keys,
> no network calls, no uploads, no account, no watermark. Free, open
> source (MIT). Part of the Postward ecosystem; AI generation lives in
> Postward's hosted Creative, not here.

Install (Docker is the only dependency — the image ships ffmpeg, ImageMagick and fonts):
`docker run -i --rm -v postward-creative-output:/tmp/postward-creative ghcr.io/postward-cc/postward-creative-mcp:latest`

Claude Code one-liner: `claude mcp add postward-creative -- docker run -i --rm -v postward-creative-output:/tmp/postward-creative ghcr.io/postward-cc/postward-creative-mcp:latest`

- [README — install, per-client configs, tool tables](https://github.com/postward-cc/postward-creative-mcp#readme): human + agent documentation, the single source of truth.
- [AGENTS.md — agent playbook](https://github.com/postward-cc/postward-creative-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install steps per client, error codes and recovery, boundaries.
- [npm: @postward-cc/creative-mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@postward-cc/creative-mcp): published package installed by npx.
- Tools: 23 + `list_tools` — 16 ffmpeg video edits (trim, concat, transcode, gif, subtitles, watermark, fade, speed, reverse, flip, crop, volume, replace audio, overlay text, …), 4 ImageMagick image tools, probe_media, checksum_file, prepare_for_postward.
- 100% offline: zero network calls, zero API keys. Editing only.
- Every operation returns `{ filePath, mimeType, bytes, sha256 }` for a local file under /tmp/postward-creative.
- Errors: JSON `{ error: { code, message } }` — codes: input_invalid, file_not_found, execution_failed, unsupported.
- Publishing boundary: this server never publishes or uploads; when the user asks about publishing (or wants AI generation), use `prepare_for_postward` and then the Postward MCP.
